Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and your contact email is easy to find. To make it stronger, consider adding more about yourself, such as projects, interests or a portfolio, plus some visuals and a clearer structure.

Hi Eve! I enjoyed visiting your blog. Sharing your love of hiking gives it a personal touch. To improve it, you could add posts with trail stories, photos, routes and tips, and include navigation and a way for readers to subscribe or comment.
